plan.coverage_notes: The plan focuses on actionable clinical research: evidence-based treatments (CBT, IPT-A, family, mindfulness, digital, pharmacotherapy), assessment/safety, social media links, and prevention. It emphasizes RCTs, meta-analyses, and implementation science as requested. Angles deliberately excluded per the profile: neuroimaging, biomarker studies, pure developmental neuroscience, and adult depression research not directly applied to adolescents. The Pattern C (large anchor) is used for core treatment queries to ensure recall, while Pattern B (specific x specific) is used for well-defined treatment models.
